mainEntity.name: What are common ice maker water line problems in the desert climate of Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the arid climate of Las Vegas, ice maker water lines can face unique challenges. High mineral content in the water can lead to scale buildup, potentially clogging lines or degrading seals over time. Additionally, prolonged exposure to high ambient temperatures, especially in less insulated areas, can accelerate the wear of plastic lines. Regular maintenance checks can help identify and mitigate these issues, preventing more significant leaks or malfunctions common in our region.
